subject: Post-call scope confirmation — dedicated GPU island & activation path
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
To: Sam Richards <sam.richards@orbisbio.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 23 May 2027 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call scope confirmation — dedicated GPU island & activation path

Hi Sam — thanks again for the time this morning. Quick recap of what we heard and the activation path we discussed, plus proposed next steps so everyone is aligned.

High-level pain & goals (as we captured):
- Intermittent latency spikes during batch inference for model-driven tertiary analyses; impacts downstream pipelines and SLA with clinicians.
- Need strict tenant isolation for PHI workloads (VPC peering, customer-managed KMS).
- Predictable unit economics for production traffic (clear committed price + burst behavior).
- Ramp from POC to prod within ~6–8 weeks if procurement and tech validation go smoothly.

Proposed dedicated configuration (initial qualification):
- Reserved pool: 8x A100-40GB (isolated tenant pool, not multi-tenant shared hosts).
- Isolation: VPC + mTLS + per-tenant encryption with customer KMS integration.
- Scaling model: 2x burst to shared reserved capacity for spikes; autoscale buckets (8 -> 12 -> shared) with grace period for warm KV cache.
- SLA targets discussed: 99.9% uptime; 95th pct latency target ~120–180ms for 0–512 token generations; P99 target to be validated in the technical workshop.

Immediate asks / acceptance criteria from Orbis Bio to proceed to sizing/quote:
1) Confirm target QPS and typical prompt/response token distribution (short examples helpful).
2) Confirm any additional compliance gating (EU data residency, audit windows) — PHI was called out so SOC2 + KMS are required.
3) Confirm procurement cadence / PO timelines so we can align the onboarding sprint.

Next steps I propose:
- Jordan / Marissa / Ben: host a 90-minute technical workshop (ops + infra + security) to validate traffic profile and run a short perf test plan (proposed dates: Tue 30 May or Wed 31 May).
- Redwood to share a preliminary capacity estimate + pricing range (attached: ORB_capacity_estimate_20270523.xlsx).
- Post-workshop: draft SOW and canary runbook for acceptance criteria, followed by procurement + provisioning.

Attachments: ORB_capacity_estimate_20270523.xlsx (capacity sketch + cost ranges)

If that captures it, say "go" and we’ll lock the workshop slot. Happy to adjust anything I missed.

— Jordan

Jordan — thanks for the clear recap. A few clarifications from our side before the workshop: 

1) Data residency: our primary tenant is US-based; one EU research partner will need a limited subset of outputs stored in EU. Can Redwood support regionally pinned KV cache or a separate EU pool?
2) Compliance: yes, PHI in scope. Please include SOC2 Type II report and a KMS integration diagram in the workshop materials. We also need to understand audit log retention options (90 days vs. 1 year).
3) Bursting: we need a clearer picture of how burst billing will be handled — is burst metered at a premium or blended into the committed rate?

Ballpark commercial ask: can you give a range for committed monthly spend for the 8x A100 pool (we know this is high-level) so our procurement team can flag budget?

We can do Tue 30 May for the workshop (90 minutes) — prefer 10:00–11:30 PT. If you can send a calendar invite and the drive folder for artifacts, I’ll confirm with procurement.
